Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_embed_async(client, "{\"input\":[\"Hello world\",\"Goodbye world\"],\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
